purpose: Deterministic bridge between canonical relationship endpoint identities and source/display naming or DLC granularity. This file never creates canonical relationships and never merges distinct canonical entities.
rules: Aliases map a source/display label to one or more explicitly named canonical targets; a one-to-many mapping must be marked as granularity, not identity.
Alias mappings do not increase canonical edge counts.
Unresolved or ambiguous mappings remain explicit rather than guessed.
DLC ownership/requirement granularity is distinct from broad pass/bundle labels.

equipment.note: External reward documentation identifies the PQ152 reward as Android 17 (DB Super) Wig, while the canonical equipment layer separately preserves the Ranger Wig identity. The repository also has an independent component/research alias record for Android 17 (DB Super)'s Ranger Accessory. Preserve the conflict rather than merging identities without inventory-level evidence.

The PQ155 reward documentation explicitly uses Gamma 2's Helmet, while the canonical equipment layer separately preserves Gamma 2 Helmet as a legacy/equipment identity. Independent item-ID documentation also identifies Gamma 2's Helmet as a distinct item name. Preserve the conflict rather than merging by punctuation/name similarity.

validation.note: This bridge is presentation/identity metadata only. It must not be added to the canonical relationship edge set. The verified current canonical baseline is 854.
